name: Pile On
hint: A plate counts everyone standing on it, even on each other's heads.
why4: The plate needs a weight of 3 but only fits one player, so three must pile up on it while the fourth fetches the key.
solution: P1 jumps onto the plate on the 1-wide pillar at x=10 (height 1).
P2 jumps from the floor onto P1's head (top at ~1.9).
P3 hops onto the 1-high step at x=12-13, then jumps onto P2's head. The counter shows 3/3 and gate A at x=21 opens.
P4 walks through the gate, hops the 2-high step at x=26-27, jumps the 3-wide pit at x=30-32, hops onto the 2-high step at x=35-37, touches the key at x=39 and comes back the same way.
P4 touches the door at x=17 with the key. P3, P2, P1 climb down; all four press Down at the door.
Recovery: if P4 falls in the pit with the key, the key returns to x=39 and P4 to the start; the pile re-forms.
